# Session fixtures

Generated by `scripts/make_session_fixtures.py`. Each file uses the exact record layout of a real session from the named tool version (record types, keys, nesting, tool-output formats, injected instructions, metadata records). The layouts were taken from the author's own sessions, which were scrubbed, reviewed and then **not committed**. The content is invented: a toy "bookshelf" API. The only secret is a fake key.

| File | Layout from | Episodes it exercises |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claude_code/cc-2.1.251-pagination.jsonl` | Claude Code 2.1.251 | Verified task (tests, commit), endorsed decision, noise (dev server) |
| `claude_code/cc-2.1.266-importer-fix.jsonl` | Claude Code 2.1.266 | Fix with a failing then passing test run, an approach replaced mid-episode, a secret in tool output |
| `claude_code/cc-2.1.281-login-only.jsonl` | Claude Code 2.1.281 | Harness-only session (`/login`), no episodes |
| `codex/codex-0.107.0-docker.jsonl` | Codex 0.107.0-alpha.5 | Build-verified task with `apply_patch`, user-stated convention |
| `codex/codex-0.117.0-explain.jsonl` | Codex 0.117.0-alpha.12 | Codebase explanation grounded in files read |
| `codex/codex-0.130.0-mixed.jsonl` | Codex 0.130.0-alpha.5 | Noise (repo access question), unverified fix (failing tests), open discussion |

Regenerate with `python scripts/make_session_fixtures.py`, then re-record judge answers with `memgate record dev-sessions tests/fixtures/sessions` and refresh the snapshot with `MEMGATE_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 pytest tests/integration/test_dev_sessions.py`.
